name: Microwave Theory and Techniques
description: Review of EM theory: Vector Calculus, Maxwell’s equations, planar waves in lossless and lossy media, polarization, reflection & refraction, energy and power; Transmission lines theory, distributed L-C model, propagation constant, reflection coefficient, lossy lines, ABCD parameters, distributed circuits, VSWR and other measurements, S-parameters and application to distributed circuits, Impedance matching and tuning; Rectangular metal waveguides (modes, fields, currents, loss, dispersion).
